messages:
maria_pm: Heads up - HW partner asked if we can create a single private-offer that bundles: upfront committed spend (3/12), a set of reserved nodes, and 'SI credits' for partner services. They want a clear renewal path and co-sell credits. Can we do this cleanly via marketplace private offers?

dan_marketplace: Yes but need to pin how discounts apply. Two options: (A) discount applies to all billable SKUs in the offer; (B) discount only applies to compute/token SKUs, credits redeemable against services. I prefer B to protect margins on managed services.

ritu_legal: Legal constraints: must avoid calling credits "cash equivalent". Credits should be non-transferable and expire at term end. Also require an MSA addendum for co-sell leads handling. For marketplace terms we need to include a "commitment schedule" section.

owen_eng: Engineering notes: Marketplace private-offer metadata supports custom fields, but we need changes to billing portal to show remaining credit balance. Lead time for provisioning reserved nodes = 4-8 weeks depending on region. If partner wants instant provisioning, offer must include burst-on-demand SKU.

sarah_mktg: For co-marketing, partner wants a joint announcement at their customer summit in ~10 weeks. We need 2 weeks for approvals from legal + brand. Who owns press draft? Also want a customer pilot by launch.

maria_pm: Proposed quick structure:
- Commit options: 3mo (min $50k), 12mo (min $300k)
- Discounts: 12% (3mo) | 22% (12mo) on compute SKUs
- SI credits: $3k (3mo) | $25k (12mo), redeemable as engineering-days (1 day = $1k)
- Reserved nodes: allocation with 30% of commit reserved for capacity booking; remaining as on-demand credits
- Renewal: auto-renew with 60-day notice to change

dan_marketplace: That looks doable. Need SKU mapping though. Suggest: RED-COMP, RED-DED-RES, RED-BURST, RED-SI-CREDIT. Also flag: "bundle_offer=true" in marketplace UI so partner sees packaged price.

owen_eng: If SI credits map to engineer-days, we need an API to ticket consumption. I'll add endpoint: POST /partner-credits/redeem {offer_id, partner_id, amount} and webhook out on success. Also we should add a usage true-up job at invoice time.

ritu_legal: Add a clause: "Unused SI credits expire and are forfeited at term end; refunds only at company discretion with admin approval." Also require audit rights for committed spend reconciliation.

sarah_mktg: PR timeline: draft in 4 weeks, legal approval in 6 weeks, creative assets at 7 weeks. Summit is week 10. We should plan a joint customer session and a demoable lab.

maria_pm: Two open questions: 1) Do discounts apply to data-transfer and infra add-ons? 2) Are partners allowed to top-up mid-term and get pro-rated benefits?

dan_marketplace: 1) I'd exclude third-party infra add-ons by default. 2) Allow top-ups but cap discount tier if top-up < 25% of original commit. Need to define pro-rata math.

owen_eng: For top-ups, we'll implement prorate as: new_effective_discount = weighted_average(old_commit*old_discount, topup*topup_discount) / (old_commit+topup). We'll add this to the billing docs.

ritu_legal: Recommend a 90-day anti-fraud clause and termination rights if commit is manipulated. Also include a requirement that partners cannot resell credits.

sarah_mktg: Who's owner for the partner-facing pricing spreadsheet? I can produce a one-pager if you give me the SKU prices.

maria_pm: @dan_marketplace — can you produce SKU price examples + a draft private-offer by EOD Tuesday? I'll coordinate with partner and loop in sales.

marketplace-bot: Private offer created: id=PO-20260420-19 (draft). Console: https://marketplace.example.com/offers/PO-20260420-19

dan_marketplace: Will do. sending spreadsheet later today. Also tagging @owen_eng for the API ticket.

maria_pm: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene next Tue after partner review. :rocket:
